description: This source file contains unit tests for the Torch JIT intermediate representation (IR) in C++. It tests attributes handling, block structures, common ancestor detection in graph nodes, and operator map functionality, utilizing Google Test framework.

classes.name: torch::jit::Graph
classes.description: Represents a computational graph in Torch JIT, supporting graph parsing, node and block management, and copying.

classes.name: torch::jit::Node
classes.description: Represents a node within the JIT graph, capable of attribute manipulation and block operations.

classes.name: torch::jit::Value
classes.description: Represents a value (tensor or data) flowing through the JIT graph, supporting ancestor block detection.

classes.name: torch::jit::OperatorMap<T>
classes.description: A mapping from operators to values or identifiers, supporting insertion, lookup, and removal.

methods.name: parseIR
methods.description: Parses an IR string into a Graph object, optionally filling a value-to-Value map.

methods.name: lint
methods.description: Performs internal consistency checks on the graph.

methods.name: findCommonAncestorBlockWith
methods.description: Finds the closest common ancestor block of two nodes in the graph.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new node with a specified symbol within a graph.

methods.name: copyAttributes
methods.description: Copies attributes from one node to another.

methods.name: eraseBlock
methods.description: Removes a block from the parent node, adjusting the graph structure.

methods.name: nodes
methods.description: Returns an iterable of nodes within a block.

methods.name: param_node
methods.description: Returns the parameter node associated with a block.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Searches in OperatorMap for a specific operator.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts new entries into an OperatorMap.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an OperatorMap contains a specific operator.

methods.name: getOperatorForLiteral
methods.description: Retrieves an operator object given its literal string representation.
